verifications.claim: Sony reports that most PlayStation Network (PSN) services have been restored as of March 22, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Sony's status page has since been updated to indicate that all services are back online.'; R5: 'The Status page now says all services are online' (updates on March 22, 2026).
verifications.reasoning: Sony's status page reports services restored/back online around March 22, 2026; 'most' aligns with context of some lingering user issues despite 'all' official status.

verifications.claim: The restoration followed a widespread, global outage that occurred on Saturday evening.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Sony's PlayStation Network suffered a widespread outage on Saturday evening'; R1/R4/R5: outage on Saturday/March 21, global impact.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly describe a widespread/global outage on Saturday evening preceding restoration.

verifications.claim: Sony's Status Page shows most, if not all, services are "up and running".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'all services are back online'; R5: 'all services are online', 'all the outage graphs continue to fall'.
verifications.reasoning: Status page explicitly shows all services online/up; 'most, if not all' matches despite some user reports of issues.

verifications.claim: Sony's Status Page previously indicated a "partial outage".
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: affected category 'Gaming & Social'; R5: 'Some services are experiencing issues'; R1/R4: specific services like 'Challenges, Game Help' impacted.
verifications.reasoning: Status page indicated issues with specific services ('some'/'Gaming & Social'), implying partial but not using exact term 'partial outage'.

verifications.claim: The outage significantly impacted user logins.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: '27% Login'; R1: 'spike in server connection & login reports'; snippet/R4: login issues reported.
verifications.reasoning: Downdetector and sources directly report login as a key impacted area (10-27% of problems).

verifications.claim: The outage significantly impacted game launching.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R4/R5: 'difficulty launching games, apps'; R3: '8% Game Launch'.
verifications.reasoning: Status page and Downdetector explicitly mention game launch difficulties/issues.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: '65% Server Connection'; snippet: '80% Server Connection'; widespread online/multiplayer issues reported.
verifications.reasoning: Primary issue was server connection/online features, dominant in reports (65-80%).

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state outage affected PS4 users.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R4: 'impacted PS4 and PS5'; R4: 'PS5 users report widespread'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state outage affected PS5 users.

verifications.claim: At the peak of the outage, Downdetector logged over 14,000 complaints.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'at the peak the number was over 14,000'.
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states Downdetector peak over 14,000 complaints.

verifications.claim: Major issues were reported in server connection.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: '65% Server Connection'; snippet/R4: 'most people faced issues with server connection'.
verifications.reasoning: Downdetector shows server connection as top issue (65-80%).

verifications.claim: Major issues were reported in login
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: '27% Login'; snippet: '10% Login'; R4: 'some could not login'.
verifications.reasoning: Login reported as significant issue (10-27% of problems) alongside server connection.
